transcript.content: I'm getting a ₹50,000 bonus this month. I'm thinking of using it to close my two-wheeler loan with Kaveri Bank. Is there any charge for closing it early?

Kaveri Bank lets you close a two-wheeler loan once 6 EMIs are paid. The charge is 4.75% of the principal outstanding if you have paid 6 to 12 EMIs, and 2.75% after 13 or more. How many EMIs have you paid?
I've paid 21 EMIs so far; 15 are left.

Then the foreclosure charge is 2.75% of the ₹46,800 outstanding: ₹1,287, plus GST. Before you do it, though: your credit card at 42% a year costs far more than the two-wheeler loan at 11%, so the bonus saves more on the card.
